correctness.rationale: Actual RESULT.md proves that two vertices in one part force all other parts through all distance-two geodesics and then all vertices; proper convex sets are exactly partial transversals. A shattered support containing a within-part pair and a third vertex cannot realize the two-vertex positive trace. Ldim upper: r+1 positive queries imply only the full hypothesis survives, so a depth r+2 binary tree is impossible. Lower: first query x splits into a positive projection with F_(r-1) and a negative branch VC-shattered by r selected vertices. Base F1 depth2 checked. Independent convex-set enumeration, all traces and version-space Littlestone recursion agree on five multipartite parameter sets incl (2,2,2,2) and (3,2,2). All n_i>=2 is necessary to the closure argument.

final_claim: For K_(n1,...,nr) with r>=2 and every n_i>=2, all convex sets are partial transversals or the whole vertex set. Shattered supports are partial transversals and within-part pairs. The shattered-support enumerator is prod(1+n_i*z)+z^2 sum C(n_i,2), VC dimension r and classical Littlestone dimension r+1.
